source_data.sql_query: SELECT r.researcher_id AS researcher_id, r.name AS name, coalesce(i.name, r.institution_id) AS institution, r.state AS state, r.department AS department, r.research_area AS research_area, r.secondary_research_areas AS secondary_research_areas, coalesce(r.h_index, 0) AS h_index, coalesce(r.total_funding_received_inr_crores, 0) AS funding_cr, r.email AS email FROM researchers r LEFT JOIN institutions i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id WHERE lower(coalesce(r.research_area, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_0) OR lower(coalesce(r.secondary_research_areas, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_0) OR lower(coalesce(r.department, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_0) OR lower(coalesce(r.research_area, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_1) OR lower(coalesce(r.secondary_research_areas, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_1) OR lower(coalesce(r.department, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_1) OR lower(coalesce(r.research_area, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_2) OR lower(coalesce(r.secondary_research_areas, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_2) OR lower(coalesce(r.department, '')) LIKE lower(:pattern_2) ORDER BY coalesce(r.h_index, 0) DESC, coalesce(r.total_funding_received_inr_crores, 0) DESC LIMIT 5
